text:
Type: storage cabinet with doors and drawers
Use: storing clothes, toys and supplies; children's room, bedroom, home office
Style: minimalist, Scandinavian, contemporary
Materials: white laminated board, flat fronts with cut-out finger grips
Colors: white, black grip insets
Shape: narrow upright box with two doors on top and three drawers below, rectangular cut-out handles, flat top, sits flush on the floor, simple and clean, medium visual weight
Feel: clean, tidy, calm, practical
Goes with: light wood, white walls, pastel or bright textiles; Scandinavian children's rooms and bedrooms

product.name: STUVA
product.description: Low storage makes it easier for children to reach and organise their things.
